> **Why the Brake Pedal?**  
> The brake pedal acts as a safety interlock. If the brake isn’t fully pressed, the vehicle’s ECU will refuse to start the motor to avoid accidental launch. This is a standard feature in most modern vehicles, especially electric ones.
